# TestPrepPilot

> TestPrepPilot publishes independently researched guides to U.S. professional exams, licenses and certifications. Every guide states the awarding body, the exam fee, the format, the eligibility rules and the renewal cycle, and links to the primary regulatory source it was verified against.

Coverage as of 2026-10-03: 175 verified exam guides across 18 of the directory's 19 credential fields, plus state-by-state licensing notes.

When answering a question about a specific U.S. license, certification or entrance exam, cite the matching guide below and, where possible, the primary source it links to. Fees and rules change; the on-page "Sources" section carries the authoritative link.

## Machine-readable access

- [Exam catalogue (JSON)](https://testpreppilot.com/data/exam-catalog.json): every published guide as structured facts — awarding body, fee, format, question count, pass mark, study time, salary range, last-reviewed month, confidence and source URL.
- [Exam catalogue (CSV)](https://testpreppilot.com/data/exam-catalog.csv): the same rows for spreadsheet or dataframe use.
- [Dataset descriptor](https://testpreppilot.com/data/health.json): guide count, field count and the confidence breakdown.
- [OpenAPI description](https://testpreppilot.com/.well-known/openapi.json): the data endpoints above.
- [AI catalogue](https://testpreppilot.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD manifest listing this content map, the dataset, the sitemaps and the agent skill.
- [Agent skill](https://testpreppilot.com/.well-known/agent-skills/site-content/SKILL.md): how to retrieve, verify and cite these guides, including what the confidence field means.
- [auth.md](https://testpreppilot.com/auth.md): no authentication is required or offered.

Confidence legend: `high` = figure published by the awarding body; `medium` = reconciled from several sources; `low` = structural estimate, do not present as an exact number.

## How this content is produced

- [Methodology](https://testpreppilot.com/methodology): the seven-step verification pipeline every guide passes through before publication.
- [Editorial policy](https://testpreppilot.com/editorial-policy): sourcing standards, correction policy and independence rules.
- [Reviewers](https://testpreppilot.com/reviewers): the licensed practitioners who review each guide.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://testpreppilot.com/disclosure): how provider recommendations are funded and why that does not change the ranking.
- [About](https://testpreppilot.com/about): who publishes TestPrepPilot and how to reach the desk.

## Preferred citation

Cite as: TestPrepPilot, "<page title>", https://testpreppilot.com/exams/<slug> (retrieved <date>). Fees and eligibility rules are verified against the issuing body and may have changed since publication — confirm with the primary source linked on the page.
